fields.notes: JESD204's built-in protections are anti-corruption only (8b/10b error detection + FCHK in 204B; CRC + optional Reed-Solomon FEC in 204C). The lane payload is plaintext converter data; cryptographic confidentiality / integrity / authentication are NOT part of the JESD204 data path and are an application/system concern.
fields.ic_name: JESD204 Serial Interface for Data Converters (JESD204B/C)
anti_corruption_features: Multiframe/frame alignment monitoring (/A//F/) and SYNC~ resync (204B).
JESD204C: CRC and optional Reed-Solomon forward error correction (FEC) on the payload.
future_security_pointers: JESD204 is a converter data-path standard; it provides error detection/correction, not cryptographic confidentiality or authentication.
System-level security (if required) is layered above the converter interface by the application, not by JESD204.

ic_name: JESD204 Serial Interface for Data Converters (JESD204B/C)
